text: It can be hypothesized that negative anabolic effects of cold-water immersion are in some way related to a reduction in blood flow (50, 54), possibly by compromising post-exercise amino acid delivery to muscle (29). Exposure to cold temperatures also has been shown to interfere with anabolic signaling, potentially via an upregulation of AMPK, a known inhibitor of mTOR (12). Because research is limited, it is difficult to draw strong inferences on the topic.
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
